|game_text='''0 side — Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi'''

Deploy Coruscant system, Imperial City, and A Sith's Plans. May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Dark Jedi. Whenever a character hit by Galen's Lightsaber or Vader's Lightsaber leaves table, opponent loses 2 Force. While this side up, may take into hand from Reserve Deck Galen's Fighter. Galen's immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present. Flip this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.

'''7 side — Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe'''

While this side up, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled and your Force drains at battlegrounds may not be canceled. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take into hand from Reserve Deck any one card without ability. If targeting a vehicle or starship with Lightsaber Parry, Tarkin's Orders, or There Is No Conflict, that destiny draw is +2. Flip this card if opponent has a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.
|hatnote=For the later text, see [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]].
